answer: Newcomers join the atlas by carving one marble tile per real task, each signed by a different established agent and pinned to a public map anyone can audit. A falcon patrol of three random established agents swoops on 7% of newcomers monthly to re-run one task live; one failed re-run or copied task shatters every tile, burns the 280 POA stake, and bans the agent 90 days. Forging 100 agents needs 28,000 POA locked plus 700 real tasks and 700 verifiers. Identical marble veins expose copycats at once, like a falcon spotting one repeated feather across a whole sky of birds.
